subject: Next steps — vendor onboarding: invoice vs. card & portal choice
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@brightedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — vendor onboarding: invoice vs. card & portal choice

Hey Laura — great conversation earlier. Thanks for walking us through BrightEdge's procurement process. Quick recap and the asks so we can keep momentum: 

1) Commercial path preference
   - You mentioned procurement prefers issuing POs for platform contracts, but smaller teams sometimes use corporate card for $<10k buys. Please confirm if the central procurement team requires PO for initial contract (yes/no).

2) Paperwork & bank details
   - We'll send our vendor packet (attached). Please confirm which vendor setup form BrightEdge needs (W-9 + banking ACH form vs. vendor portal enrollment).

3) Marketplace listing
   - You flagged interest in listing Redwood on your internal marketplace for easy reorders. Is that a separate intake or part of the standard vendor activation? If separate, please share contact or form.

4) Timeline & next step owner
   - If PO path: estimated time to issue a PO after vendor packet + W-9 is received.
   - If card: who on your side should we invoice and what billing email to use?

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_v1.1.pdf (PDF) — includes W-9, ACH bank template, and contact info.

Next steps from our side: I’ll drop the packet here and follow up on Monday to see whether procurement wants the packet routed through the portal vs. a direct finance intake. If there’s anything else procurement needs (tax forms, insurance cert), let me know and we’ll include it in the packet.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

-----

From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@brightedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightEdge Procurement <procurement@brightedge.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — vendor onboarding: invoice vs. card & portal choice

Thanks Ben — appreciated the recap. Quick answers below: 

- PO vs card: For any new vendor on the platform, central procurement issues a PO. Cards are only used for approved marketplaces or existing suppliers. So yes — we need a PO for the initial Redwood contract.

- Paperwork: Please submit the W-9 and completed ACH form. We can accept the paperwork either attached to the vendor portal enrollment or emailed to procurement@brightedge.com. Portal onboarding shortens the review time (typically 3–5 business days). Email submission is manual and takes ~7–10 business days.

- Marketplace: Marketplace listing is a separate intake handled by our vendor programs team; procurement will collect the standard packet first, then route to vendor programs if approved. I’ve CC’d procurement so they have visibility.

Would prefer portal enrollment if Redwood can complete the fields there — saves us a backlog step.

Best,
Laura Simmons
Director, Partnerships | BrightEdge
laura.simmons@brightedge.com

On Mon, Jun 28, 2027 at 09:45 AM Procurement <procurement@brightedge.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben / Redwood team,
>
> Thanks for sending the packet. Confirming we require: signed W-9 (or W-8 for internationals), completed banking/ACH form, and COI (certificate of insurance) for vendors providing software services. Once we receive those items via portal, we can issue an initial PO within 3 business days.
>
> If you prefer to be listed in the marketplace, please indicate so in the portal notes and we’ll route accordingly after activation.
>
> Procurement Team
> BrightEdge
